starting_class: Fresh half-activations of balanced odd-majority cores, with an asymptotic logarithmic surcharge.
new_class: Fresh half-activations of arbitrary balanced Boolean cores in every finite dimension.

universal_gap: Prevent reuse of the same physical child influence when the logarithmic credit is transported through multiple coherent activation ancestors.
